In today’s show, we will discuss:
1. Cancer cases on the rise in India: National Cancer Awareness Day is observed annually in India on November 7. What are the biggest reasons behind the rising number of cancer cases in India? Why more young people are being diagnosed with cancer? Which cancers are most commonly found in Indian men & women? What are the early warning signs of cancer & can cancer be prevented? Guest: Dr. J.P. Agarwal, Director, Head & Neck Cancer Institute of India.
